svg.aria-label: Ten other robot benchmarks and RoboTeam, by robot arms on one task and how long one run can last. Every other benchmark has 1 to 4 arms and runs of at most 4 hours; RoboTeam has 16 arms and runs of up to 24 hours. 图中未标名的还有 RoCoBench、RoboTwin、RobotWorld、RoboColiseum、ReflexBench、EmbodiedBench 和 VLABench。
